You smash one enemy back, then sweep your weapon low, sending fallen foes skidding into the ranks behind.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Brawn
Target / range / shape
One adjacent enemy and every other Prone enemy adjacent to you.
Equipment / acquisition
Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.
Type
Skill / Attack

Make a Brawn melee attack. Apply the result to each target.

Weak
4 physical damage; push it 2 squares directly away from you.
Standard
5 physical damage; push it 3 squares directly away from you and apply Prone.
Strong
7 physical damage; push it 4 squares directly away from you and apply Prone.
